record.field: /* KPI: Total Job Cards */ select coalesce(count(*),0) as total_job_cards from res_users ru left join res_users_work_center_location_rel ruwcll on ruwcll.res_users_id = ru.id left join project_task pt on pt.work_center_id = ruwcll.work_center_location_id where 1=1 and pt.active = true and ru.id = {#UID} and service_created_datetime between %(ks_start_datetime)s and %(ks_end_datetime)s

/* Tile: Total service Revenue */ select sum(pt.grand_total) as total_service_revenue from res_users ru left join res_users_work_center_location_rel ruwcll on ruwcll.res_users_id = ru.id left join project_task pt on pt.work_center_id = ruwcll.work_center_location_id where 1=1 and ru.id = {#UID} and service_created_datetime between %(ks_start_datetime)s and %(ks_end_datetime)s

/* Tile: Labor Revenue */ select sum(pt.service_grand_total_amount) as total_service_revenue from res_users ru left join res_users_work_center_location_rel ruwcll on ruwcll.res_users_id = ru.id left join project_task pt on pt.work_center_id = ruwcll.work_center_location_id where 1=1 and ru.id = {#UID} and service_created_datetime between %(ks_start_datetime)s and %(ks_end_datetime)s

/* Tile: Spare Parts Revenue */ select sum(pt.parts_grand_total_amount) as total_service_revenue from res_users ru left join res_users_work_center_location_rel ruwcll on ruwcll.res_users_id = ru.id left join project_task pt on pt.work_center_id = ruwcll.work_center_location_id where 1=1 and ru.id = {#UID} and service_created_datetime between %(ks_start_datetime)s and %(ks_end_datetime)s

/* Spare Parts Warranty */ select coalesce(sum(ip.value_float), 0) as spareparts_warranty from res_users ru left join res_users_work_center_location_rel ruwcll on ruwcll.res_users_id = ru.id left join project_task pt on pt.work_center_id = ruwcll.work_center_location_id left join product_lines pl on pl.project_task_id = pt.id left join ir_property ip on cast(split_part(ip.res_id, ',', 2) as integer) = pl.product_id where 1=1 and pt.service_warranty_id in ('1','2','6') and pt.active = true and ip.type = 'float' and ip.name = 'standard_price' and ru.id = {#UID} and pt.service_created_datetime between %(ks_start_date)s and %(ks_end_date)s

Job Cards - Status analysis on weekly basis

SELECT 'Week-' || ( FLOOR((EXTRACT(DAY FROM service_created_datetime) - 1) / 7) + 1 ) AS week_no,
sum(CASE WHEN (job_card_state = 'Cancelled' or job_card_state = 'Closed') THEN 0 else 1 END) AS not_closed,
sum(CASE WHEN job_card_state = 'Closed' THEN 1 else 0 END) AS closed,
sum(CASE WHEN job_card_state = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 else 0 END) AS cancelled
FROM project_task
WHERE service_created_datetime >= %(ks_start_date)s AND service_created_datetime <= %(ks_end_date)s /* 7: Central; 6: East; 5: West */ and work_center_group_id = '5' and active = true
GROUP BY week_no ORDER BY week_no
